head: 1788675d
premiseCorrection: exec-* dirs under reports/audit/round-7 are executor --out RESULT directories, not in-flight input-manifest containers. Also: manifest-detail.json is NOT an input manifest — it is a DOWNSTREAM conversion artifact written by scripts/qa/exec-frames-to-corpus.mjs (its own harness field names the exec-results.json it consumed), so its presence proves MORE progress than its absence. Presence/absence of manifest-detail.json therefore cannot be used as an executed/unexecuted discriminator (it is absent in 11 dirs that did run).

enumerationCounts.reconciliation: 18 matches nothing measured (not 36, not 33, not 30, not 3, not 11). Closest real numbers: 4 dirs are named exec-real-coverage-*-r9 (the round-8-coverage remedy wave, gitSha a4c8f995), and 11 dirs lack manifest-detail.json. Most likely stale basis: the orchestrator counted a pre-existing snapshot before the r9/r10 waves ran.

gate.name: verify-real-coverage
gate.invoked_from: scripts/qa/run-final-verify-v33.sh:42 -> scripts/qa/verify-real-coverage.mjs (no special flag; per-row uncovered list is now unconditional)

other_visible_leaks.bandless_source: exec-ws-tap-r8 (145 rows, no band field at all — produced by r-exec-ws.mjs)

gate.decisive_reading: REALCOV_NEVER_ON_REAL=0. Not one of the 10 debts is missing a real-band row. All 10 have real-band rows and all of them are SKIPPED (REAL_BAND_BUT_ALL_SKIPPED=10). So this is NOT a band-coverage problem and re-running band sweeps cannot fix it.

showcase.warning: showcase declares apiMode=real (measured in reports/audit/round-7/band-freshness-final.json, no dist read). verify-real-coverage claims rows by /^real(@|$)/, so a SHOWCASE-band leg is counted as real coverage. 5 round-7 dirs (exec-A-showcase-r8e, exec-ch12-knife, exec-interact-*-r10 x3, exec-real-coverage-*-showcase-r9) ran against the showcase project and stamped band=real@ed1cd82c. Distinguish by the sha8, not the mode word.

bands.dist_read: NOT read — rebuild in flight. sha8 values above come from the ops corpus and from the declared band fields inside the existing exec-results.json files. Freshness at run time is deferred-to-run-time.

classificationCounts.note: the 1 is 次要18|TD03, blocked only by the DENY_TAP prose regex.

overlapWithUncovered.detail: Thirteen of the 33 dirs already declare ALL 10 debt rows inside their own scope (see full_scope_dirs_computed), and the exec-real-coverage-*-r9 wave was built for exactly this purpose. They ran. All 10 rows came back SKIPPED on every real-band leg. The rows are still uncovered BECAUSE those runs skipped them, not because they never ran. Re-running the same dirs with the same flags reproduces the same skips; resuming into them is additionally a guaranteed no-op (see hazards). Note that 3 of these dirs are MOCK-band legs (mock@f1c7b96b) whose rows the gate cannot claim at all — mock scope presence is not real coverage. Every one of the 10 real-band full-scope dirs ran with the plain observe/tap slice: none of --rapid / --scroll / --gestures / --native-capture / --geom-pos / --net-count appears in its declared runner field.
